text: Marelli filed for Chapter 11 in the United States on 11 June 2025, and its restructuring provides for the DIP lenders to take ownership of the business upon emergence from chapter 11.
short: Marelli's DIP lenders are to own it on emergence from Chapter 11.

source.name: Marelli: Marelli Initiates Voluntary U.S. Chapter 11 Proceedings to Strengthen Financial Position and Facilitate a Value-Maximizing Restructuring
source.quote: the DIP Lenders will take ownership of the business upon emergence from chapter 11, subject to a 45-day overbid process

additionalSources.name: Marelli: Marelli Receives Court Approval of "Second Day" Motions to Support Business Operations
additionalSources.note: Same publisher (Marelli press releases), later statement of the expected emergence under lender ownership.
additionalSources.quote: expects to emerge from Chapter 11 in 2026 under the ownership of its principal lenders
